svg.title: SoccerBotStudio high-level architecture, component uses and costs
svg.desc: Documentation snapshot, 4 October 2026. Frontend demo exists; cloud and provider integrations planned. Browser execution belongs to the user.
svg.text: 4 OCT 2026 / Initial frontend review / SGD = S$ · USD = US$ · prices per month unless stated
Diagram shows the target. Only green demo components exist.
Free static requests; build limits apply
Minimal verification, session and access state
US$5 minimum paid plan + possible usage
Owns booking, schedule, instructor and capacity
Binds accepted bookings to hosted checkout
Exact fee tiers and extra charges below
Free Developer tier; paid access TBD
Checks public site and API uptime
Included in booking plan; SMS/WhatsApp extra.
Browser return URL is never payment proof.
All tools below have no additional software licence fee. Cloud usage, devices and engineering time remain separate.
Types and validation for domain, contact and stored data.
Compile responsive styles into one canonical stylesheet.
Brand/content, accessible controls and synthetic demo persistence.
Booking exports and local simulations; no LLM or message delivery.
Semantic/type/source checks; stronger policy checks still missing.
Browser journey / device evidence; canonical WebKit pending.
Test forms/state; reject incomplete execution and CI-policy bypass.
Deploy named environments and verify real server boundaries.
NEXT: SoccerBotStudioSG source upload → reviewed PR / Actions → Cloudflare deployment later
GitHub Free: repo + 2,000 Actions minutes / 500 MB artifacts. Private branch protection needs Pro/Team or higher.
Selected repo exists publicly; connection is read-only. No candidate upload, CI run or deployment yet.
Quotation target: S$60–150/mo. Free-email line items: S$60–120; all paid-email upper allowances total S$180.
Cloudflare S$10–20 is one combined allowance. Excludes tax, payment fees, maintenance and optional paid monitoring/GitHub.
HitPay online: PayNow <S$100 = 0.9% (min S$0.20); S$100+ = 0.65% + S$0.30. Domestic cards = 2.8% + S$0.50.
Applicable software/platform fees are extra. Domain already paid; quoted renewal estimate S$20–40/year (registrar prevails).
Build with developer test accounts → client staging/UAT → client production. Re-map IDs/config; never copy test records or secrets.
No custom staff login. OpenAI, WhatsApp, Queues/Cron, staff Access/Workspace are future-only; no current spend or implementation.
* Annual-equivalent pricing requires annual billing. Official sources, exact entitlements and the full component inventory are in Rules & Architecture.
